# Unit Tests CMake Configuration
# Generated by PLCOpen Test Enhancement Initiative

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

# Unit test target definitions
set(UNIT_TEST_SOURCES
    test_real_time_scheduler.cpp
    test_memory_manager.cpp
    test_lockfree_structures.cpp
    test_error_handler.cpp
)

# Include directories for unit tests
include_directories(
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include/test
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
)

# Create individual test executables for better isolation
foreach(TEST_SOURCE ${UNIT_TEST_SOURCES})
    # Extract test name from filename
    get_filename_component(TEST_NAME ${TEST_SOURCE} NAME_WE)
    
    # Create executable for this test
    add_executable(${TEST_NAME} ${TEST_SOURCE})
    
    # Link required libraries
    target_link_libraries(${TEST_NAME} 
        scheduler
        memory_manager
        io_system
        fb_system
        st_compiler
        pthread
    )
    
    # Set C++17 standard
    target_compile_features(${TEST_NAME} PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
    
    # Add compiler flags for testing
    target_compile_options(${TEST_NAME} PRIVATE
        -Wall -Wextra -g -O0
        -DUNIT_TESTING=1
        -DDEBUG_MODE=1
    )
    
    # Add to test suite
    add_test(NAME ${TEST_NAME} COMMAND ${TEST_NAME})
    
    # Set test properties
    set_tests_properties(${TEST_NAME} PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 30
        LABELS "unit;core"
    )
endforeach()

# Create unified unit test runner
add_executable(run_unit_tests run_all_unit_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(run_unit_tests 
    scheduler
    memory_manager
    io_system
    fb_system
    st_compiler
    pthread
)
target_compile_features(run_unit_tests PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(run_unit_tests PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -g -O0)

# Coverage support (optional)
if(ENABLE_COVERAGE)
    target_compile_options(run_unit_tests PRIVATE --coverage)
    target_link_options(run_unit_tests PRIVATE --coverage)
endif()
